articles.title: A Super Reunion: Corenswet, Strahovski, and Arnaud Tackle a Broadway Mystery
articles.summary: A cryptic journal, a rainy loft, and a family's buried secrets—"Three Days of Rain" returns to Broadway with a star-studded cast. David Corenswet (Superman), Yvonne Strahovski, and François Arnaud will star in the 2027 revival. The 2006 production famously marked Julia Roberts's stage debut.

articles.title: A 23,000-Square-Foot Embrace: How a Grass Painting United Minneapolis
articles.summary: On a Minneapolis lawn, a colossal biodegradable painting of clasping arms stretches 310 feet. Created by artist Saype, it's the first U.S. piece in his "Beyond Walls" series. Hundreds of residents formed a human chain around it, a poignant act of solidarity after recent turmoil.

articles.title: A Physicist Paints Einstein's Relativity Across the Desert Sky
articles.summary: Dr. Elliot McGucken, a physicist developing an artificial retina, uses drones and long-exposure photography to create luminous "light cones" over remote landscapes. Inspired by Einstein's 1922 book, the series visualizes the deep link between space, time, and light. Each image is a fleeting sculpture on nature's canvas.
